document_summary: Boston Department of Neighborhood Development Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (February 2017) limiting use of criminal history and credit scores by housing providers receiving DND funding/land or operating BPDA inclusionary units in Boston, MA.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy - criminal history
rules.requirement: Covered housing providers may not use a blanket ban on applicants with arrests or convictions and must review applicants case-by-case. They may not consider non-conviction arrests, judicially relieved convictions, juvenile records, or convictions more than 5 years old when determining eligibility or considering eviction.
rules.key_value: No consideration of non-conviction arrests, expunged/sealed convictions, juvenile records, or convictions over 5 years old
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or with income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy; also applied to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity Affirmative Marketing Program.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply where there is a direct relationship between a conviction and the housing sought and/or unreasonable risk of substantial harm to the safety of others; does not apply to current criminal behavior; conflicting federal or state criminal-history requirements preempt the policy.
rules.interaction: Federal or state law imposing a conflicting criminal history requirement preempts this policy.
rules.citation: Boston DND Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (Feb. 2017)
rules.quoted_span: The Developer/Agent (Agent) agrees to not consider any of the following categories when determining housing eligibility and or considering eviction: a) Arrests that did not result in conviction. This includes dismissed charges, diversion programs, and similar non-convictions. b) Convictions that are subject to a form of judicial relief, such as expungement, sealing, and certificates for relief from disabilities. c) Juvenile records d) A conviction more than 5 years old.
rules.extraction_notes: Policy is dated February 2017 (page header); no effective date stated, so effective_date is null. Applies to funded/inclusionary housing providers by agreement, not all Boston landlords. Mitigating-factor guidance and appeals process are encouraged/'should' items, folded out.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy - credit
rules.requirement: Covered housing providers agree not to use an applicant's credit score to approve or deny housing applications. Credit history may be considered only in lieu of rental history when rental history is unavailable, and lack of credit history alone is not sufficient to reject an applicant.
rules.key_value: No use of credit scores to approve or deny applications
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or with income restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.
rules.citation: Boston DND Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (Feb. 2017)
rules.quoted_span: The agent agrees not to use the applicant credit score to approve or deny housing applications.
rules.extraction_notes: Policy dated February 2017; no effective date stated, so effective_date is null. Applies to funded/inclusionary housing providers only.
